newsitem.title: UK: Lithuania's Birzai Milk plans intl share offer.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania's Birzai Milk plans intl share offer.

text.p: Birzai Milk, the second largest dairy in Lithuania, has mandated Nomura Securities and Vilniaus Banka to undertake a $6.0 million international equity offering, Nomura said in a statement.
"Proceeds of the capital increase will be used to further expand Birzai's product range and to re-enter the company's historic export markets, such as Latvia and Russia," the statement said.
The offering will comprise 57 percent of the company's enlarged share capital and will be in the form of depositary receipts.
Birzai, based in northern Lithuania, processed 90,000 tonnes of milk in 1995 and had sales of 88 million litas. It made a net profit of 2.4 million litas.
The company has completed accounts to international standards.
